name: Gnoll
summary: Across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, gnoll packs prey on settlements and travelers. Hyena-like scavengers, they are known for vicious infighting, brutal strength, and animal cunning. Their warlords lead raids, butcher wildlife, and threaten frontier hamlets and trade roads.

sections.title: Hyenas of the Wilds
sections.body:
Gnolls roam the wilds on two legs or all fours. Slightly shorter than an average human, these hyena-kin have thick pelts, spiky teeth, and a barking laugh. They lope swiftly through brush and track prey by scent.

Among gnolls, raw strength rules. Fractious packs follow the strongest and cruelest alpha. They yield only when a superior force batters them into submission.

sections.title: The Gnoll War
sections.body: United gnolls once brought open war to the kingdom of Stormwind. Stormwind's armies defeated them, and the kingdom knew lasting peace until the orcs came through the Dark Portal.

sections.title: Raiders of the Southern Kingdoms
sections.body:
With Stormwind's full military might absent from the south, gnoll packs run rampant. In Elwynn Forest and Westfall, the Riverpaw pack follows the notorious Hogger. They raid homesteads and force subjugated kobolds to dig for gold. The pack secretly colludes with the Defias Brotherhood.

Farther east, the Redridge pack snatches horses outside Lakeshire and sabotages bridge repairs. In Galardell Valley, the Shadowhide clan serves the dark will of the rogue wizard Morganth.

sections.title: Pestilence and Territory
sections.body:
Gnolls threaten lands beyond the human south. In northern Lordaeron, the Scourge necromancer Thule Ravenclaw raises undead Rot Hide gnolls to dig up corpses across Tirisfal and Silverpine. Near Hillsbrad, the Mudsnout harvest foul, toxic blossoms among ruined farmsteads.

Across the Great Sea in Kalimdor, the Palemane pack butchers game across Mulgore despite tauren efforts to make peace. In Feralas, the Woodpaw wage a desperate, frenzied war against encroaching silithid swarms.

faq.answer: Gnolls are hyena-like humanoid carnivores, feared for their violence, endurance, and low cunning. They roam in nomadic or semi-permanent camps, living mostly on plunder, hunting, and carrion.

faq.q: Why don't gnolls form a proper kingdom?
faq.answer: Gnolls follow fierce, immediate hierarchies. Without an exceptional, tyrannical warlord to beat them into line, packs splinter into bloody territorial feuds. Long-term organization and civil progress cannot take hold.
Long before the First War, united gnoll packs waged war on the kingdom of Stormwind. Stormwind's armies prevailed, and the kingdom knew lasting peace until the orcs came through the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Why are gnolls working with the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: The Riverpaw pack in Westfall and Elwynn colludes with the Defias Brotherhood for arms, coordination, and shared spoils. The bandits use the gnolls as brute muscle to overrun farmlands and distract Stormwind's dwindling garrisons.

faq.q: Are the Rot Hide gnolls alive?
faq.answer: No. The Rot Hide gnolls in Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest are undead thralls. They answer to Thule Ravenclaw, an exiled human necromancer who uses Fenris Isle as a redoubt to gather corpses for the Scourge.

faq.q: Why do tauren fight the Palemane gnolls?
faq.answer: When the tauren settled Mulgore, they tried to coexist and communicate with the indigenous Palemane pack. The gnolls rebuffed every peaceful gesture, slaughtered plains wildlife without restraint, and threatened tauren villages.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, gnolls are an ancient enemy who once burned the kingdom's heartlands. Today, packs like the Riverpaw and Shadowhide threaten the kingdom's vulnerable frontier roads.
As a tauren, you know the Palemane tribe treats Mulgore with careless cruelty. Young tauren braves must drive them back to preserve the balance of the plains.
Alliance marshals across Elwynn, Westfall, Redridge, and the Wetlands rely heavily on freelance champions to thin the encroaching gnoll populations.
The Forsaken see gnolls as either an annoyance or a resource. In Hillsbrad, the Mudsnout cultivate restorative fungi, while Sylvanas previously enslaved northern packs through banshee possession.
